title: New Horizons for Women: Hine Kahukura Education Awards
official_source: New Horizons for Women: Hine Kahukura
program_type: Charitable trust grant programme (women returning to education, with targeted streams for refugee, migrant, Pasifika, STEM, trade and solo-parent students)
duration: One-off award for a single qualification; a previous recipient cannot apply again at the same level of study
description: The Education Awards are an annual programme of sponsored grants from the New Zealand charitable trust New Horizons for Women: Hine Kahukura, supporting women returning to or continuing education. Awards are sized by qualification level, at NZD 1,000 for NZQCF levels 3-4, NZD 1,500 for levels 5-6 and NZD 3,000 for level 7. Targeted streams exist for refugee and migrant women, STEM degree students, trade and apprenticeship women, solo parents, and Pasifika women in Early Childhood or Primary Education.

title: Sonja Davies Peace Award Fund
official_source: New Horizons for Women: Hine Kahukura
program_type: Charitable trust project grant (women-led peace and conflict-resolution initiatives, open to tertiary students)
duration: One-off grant for a defined project with a submitted timeline and budget
description: The Sonja Davies Peace Award Fund promotes initiatives that advance peace in New Zealand and is open to a woman, or a group led by a woman, developing an initiative at home, school, the workplace or in the community. It commemorates Sonja Davies, a New Zealand women's rights campaigner and politician, and includes work on family violence, inter-group understanding, mediation and conflict resolution. Awards are worth up to NZD 4,000, and the Trust publishes the 2026 application window as 12 to 30 October.

title: ILSC Humanitarian Scholarship
program_type: Private education provider scholarship (refugees and asylum seekers on Australian humanitarian visas)
duration: Three sessions, with one session lasting four weeks except in December
description: The ILSC Humanitarian Scholarship gives refugees living in Australia three sessions of English language study to overcome the language barrier that stops newly arrived refugees from entering tertiary education or employment. It covers 11 to 12 weeks of English tuition in groups, all learning materials and resources, and administrative fees, plus free Duolingo Premium for the placement. Two scholarships per campus are available every three sessions, and applications are open year-round.

title: Joint Algeria/Ghana Government Scholarship Awards 2026/2027 (tenable in Algeria)
official_source: Government of the People's Democratic Republic of Algeria, announced by the Ghana Scholarships Authority (Republic of Ghana)
duration: Undergraduate: a degree programme; Vocational education and technical training: 2 years; Religious studies (Imam training): 3 years; Master's in Islamic Studies: 2 years, preceded by one year of French language training
description: A joint Algerian and Ghanaian government scholarship for the 2026/2027 academic year, tenable in Algeria and allocated to Ghanaian citizens by the Ghana Scholarships Authority. It is unusual in the breadth of levels it covers: undergraduate university study in science, technology, mathematics, computer science, architecture, medicine, veterinary science, dentistry, agricultural science, pharmacy and urban planning; a two-year vocational and technical professional certificate; three-year Imam training for candidates with Arabic and Quran memorisation; and a two-year Master's in Islamic Studies

title: Scholarship Opportunities in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (Study in Saudi — Ghana allocation)
official_source: Government of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, announced by the Ghana Scholarships Authority (Republic of Ghana)
description: Scholarship awards at six selected Saudi universities — Taif, Madinah, Jazan, Najran, Tabuk and Fahad Bin Sultan University — announced by the Ghana Scholarships Authority and applied for through the Saudi Ministry of Education's Study in Saudi platform. The call is open to Ghanaian citizens resident in Ghana who hold a genuine birth certificate and a passport, and covers programmes in technology management, business management, Islamic economics, marketing, engineering, technology, medicine, education and architecture. Applications close on 28 October 2026.

title: Heydar Aliyev International Education Grant (Study in Azerbaijan project)
official_source: Ministry of Science and Education of the Republic of Azerbaijan
duration: Five years of study, matching the five-year lifetime of the grant programme, with annual award rounds
description: The Heydar Aliyev International Education Grant is an educational grant programme of the Government of Azerbaijan, established by presidential decree of 8 July 2023 and run by the Ministry of Science and Education through the Study in Azerbaijan project, for citizens of Organisation of Islamic Cooperation and Non-Aligned Movement member states, small island developing states, and countries with ethnic, historical or cultural ties to Azerbaijan. title: Government of Guyana Scholarships
official_source: Ministry of Public Service, Government Efficiency and Implementation, Government of Guyana
duration: Duration of the award as advertised for each scholarship category
description: The Government of Guyana advertises and administers its national scholarship awards through the Ministry of Public Service, Government Efficiency and Implementation in three categories: undergraduate, technical and vocational education, and postgraduate, based on national workforce requirements. Beneficiaries receive full tuition plus allowances for books, outfit and travelling, and graduates are bonded by contract and guaranteed a public sector job after completing their studies.
